title: The pedestal
starting_code: # Walk to the stone. Pick up the wand. Keep going.
hints: Move three steps to reach the stone.
Use the `pick_up` method to take the wand.
Move three more steps to the end of the path.
intro: I set my spare wand on that stone for you. Go pick it up. I will lend it to you for now.
outro: You have a wand! You will give it back to me one day. Let us keep moving.
learned: Now you know that things you carry are objects too.
